en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a church complex with a central baroque-style tower and arched entrance, flanked by tall trees and adjacent buildings. In the background to the left, three crosses stand on a hill, reinforcing the Calvary theme. There are a few people in period clothing in front of the gate. The lower margin of the image is printed with the caption identifying the church and the city, and the left margin lists the publisher. Handwritten notes appear along the right edge.
